content:
Headquarters: Portugal, remote, Germany, Greifswald



Your mission


As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you play a central role in enabling reliable, scalable, and observable operation of a new, strategically important web-based product within the myneva portfolio. You work closely with development teams to ensure that software can be deployed, operated, and evolved efficiently across different environments and customer setups.
You act as the technical expert for containerization, deployment models, and operational architecture, helping teams make informed decisions around infrastructure, networking, hardware requirements, and runtime environments. In this role, you combine deep technical expertise with a strong enablement mindset, supporting development teams with tools, standards, and guidance — including the effective use of AI-supported tools in modern DevOps practices.

Your Responsibilities
  • You design and maintain container-based deployment setups using Docker and related technologies.
  • You define repeatable deployment and runtime models across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • You build and maintain deployment and environment automation to ensure reliable and auditable operations.
  • You support development teams with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release processes.
  • You design and improve observability solutions (monitoring, logging, tracing) for reliable operations.
  • You advise on infrastructure topics such as networking, security, hardware requirements, and scalability.
  • You collaborate closely with development and product teams to ensure operability is considered early.
  • You use AI-assisted tools to improve operational efficiency while critically validating their outputs.




Your profile


  • You have several years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure-related roles.
  • You have strong hands-on experience with Docker and container-based deployment models.
  • You have solid knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and operational best practices.
  • You have experience operating distributed systems across cloud and/or hybrid environments.
  • You understand infrastructure, networking, and security fundamentals.
  • You enjoy enabling development teams with standards, tooling, and guidance.
  • You have experience using AI-supported tools in operational contexts responsibly.
  • You communicate confidently in English (C1 level); German is an advantage.




Why us?


  • A responsible task with meaning: We build software to digitize the social care sector and thus enable our customers to focus on a better life for their clients by giving them more time for care & support 
  • A remote working time model to keep your everyday life flexible 
  • Exciting, challenging tasks in a dynamic, future-oriented environment 
  • A culture of appreciation and a harmonious working atmosphere in a growing, international company with opportunities to get involved 
  • A creative working environment, flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes 
  • Attractive remuneration models, a permanent employment contract 




contact information


If this sounds like you, we look forward to receiving your application including your earliest possible start date, through our online application form!



About us


Welcome to myneva - together, we shape digital care.

myneva is one of the leading European software providers for the social sector. Our solutions focus on shaping the world around our clients and their needs. By digitising processes, we help care givers gain more time to support their clients, enabling them to enjoy a better quality of life.    

As an ambitious team, we are pursuing increasing internationalisation and a clear mission to become #1 in Europe.
